title: What remains, surveyed across the whole OLE2 and OOXML data path
code_state: no file under crates/ was modified by this batch
reason_codes: the ranked work queue in HOTSPOTS.md cited nothing later than change 0190 and no record ranked opportunities across areas; this record replaces it with a 36-item queue screened against all 586 prior records
every fresh figure is a single-leg count or instruction profile with no A/A control, so no speedup, regression or resource claim is admissible from this batch

the top-ranked item (MCE codec namespace re-declaration, 12.9x on one real fixture) is sized on one fixture and its breadth is a count of 41 of 60 fixtures, so its corpus-wide size is the first measurement its design record must take
nothing in the queue is authorized by this record: ten items need a paired measurement, twenty-one a frozen design record, five a proposed ADR or an ADR clarification

accepted_evidence.survey_reports: eleven per-area reports, each with a path map, ranked opportunities carrying record status and an evidence tier (measured, retained, modelled, unknown), a not-an-opportunity list and measurement blockers; retained verbatim
accepted_evidence.fresh_counts: logged positional requests, source observations and allocations for OOXML opens and part reads; strace syscall counts per open for XLS facade, file-source and save routes; xlsb_crud single-leg timings; allocator-harness reports for XLSX commit and read scenarios
accepted_evidence.fresh_profiles: callgrind isolation pairs or single runs for the eager DOC open, the DOC and PPT source snapshot opens, the eager XLSX open-edit-save, the DOCX one-edit save, the PPTX batch edit save and cross copy, and the eager and source-backed XLSX open plus one cell on a real fixture against a marker-stripped control; native perf stat and perf record beside the hashing-dominated ones
accepted_evidence.fresh_micro_measurements: litchi-core source observation, read and budget-charge costs; type sizes for the XLS and XLSX hot types
accepted_evidence.fixture_censuses: MCE marker, cols, shared-string and relationship presence across the real XLSX fixtures; OLE2 corpus byte layout; DOC refusal reasons across all .doc fixtures
accepted_evidence.coordinator_verification: eight cited mechanisms checked against the source before ranking: the codec's per-element namespace emission, the three identity fingerprints per DOC snapshot open, the PPTX fingerprint sites, the per-part .rels audit in the publication plan, the eager error construction in the XLS frame loop, the facade's .doc byte ingress, the per-read ZIP session, the unconditional XLSB reparse

accepted_costs.single_leg: every fresh number is one leg on a warm page cache with other agents active on the host; no host-quiescence log
accepted_costs.instruction_counts: instructions rank work, not latency; rep movsb/stosb are counted per byte; SHA-256 runs in software under valgrind, so hashing shares are about five times their native cycle share
accepted_costs.whole_child_shares: the DOCX and PPTX callgrind shares are whole-child because no selector times those phases separately
accepted_costs.token_economy: the first wave of eleven agents was terminated by a session usage cap before reading anything and was relaunched under a reading cap; coverage depth is what each report shows and no deeper

known_gaps.not_surveyed: litchi-crypto, litchi-sign and litchi-vba paths; conversion and export sinks; DOCX and PPTX streaming writers beyond 0473-0478; ODF (deferred) and iWork (excluded)
known_gaps.selectors: no selector exists for DOC or PPT facade opens, OLE2 length-changing saves, the ordinary OOXML save, XLS full text or all cells, file-backed cold part reads, PPTX phase timers or eager DOCX phases
known_gaps.corpora: the harness corpora omit MCE markers, cols, shared strings, worksheet relationships and physical provenance, and every source is in memory; the largest OLE2 fixture is 1.6 MB with no DIFAT, the largest XLSB 22.7 KB, the largest marker-bearing worksheet 210 KB

withheld: any speedup, regression, cold-cache, physical-device, range-source, peak-RSS, allocation-profile, concurrency-scaling, real-producer or cross-platform result

provenance.host: AMD EPYC 9R45, 32 cores, 123 GiB, Linux 7.0.0-1012-aws, rustc 1.95.0, valgrind 3.26.0
provenance.note: all measurements were taken on the shared warm workspace build or scratch projects with path dependencies; no worktree was created and no tracked file was modified by any survey
